verdict.rationale: monday.com documents in-app AI agents that users configure by defining goals and rules or describing workflows. None of the evidence shows an assistant that learns a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences to tailor its output. Manually setting agent rules is an adjacent configuration feature, not learned personalization, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
